nodes.text: Create a quiet medieval hamlet on gently rolling grassland beneath a bright cloudy sky. Arrange roughly a dozen buildings loosely around branching dirt lanes and open courtyards, leaving countryside visible at every edge. Mix one- and two-story timber-framed houses with pale infill, dark wooden barns, and larger rectangular stone buildings, all with steep thatched roofs. Place the largest houses near the central junction and barns and stone structures around the perimeter facing paths or clearings. Add small sheds and an open-sided thatched work shelter with simple equipment and a faint warm glow. Include raised doorways, stone steps, porches, smoking chimneys, and worn earth, keeping the settlement minimally furnished and moderately spaced.

Create a quiet medieval hamlet on gently rolling grassland beneath a bright cloudy sky. Arrange roughly a dozen buildings loosely around branching dirt lanes and open courtyards, leaving countryside visible at every edge. Mix one- and two-story timber-framed houses with pale infill, dark wooden barns, and larger rectangular stone buildings, all with steep thatched roofs. Place the largest houses near the central junction and barns and stone structures around the perimeter facing paths or clearings. Add small sheds and an open-sided thatched work shelter with simple equipment and a faint warm glow. Include raised doorways, stone steps, porches, smoking chimneys, and worn earth, keeping the settlement minimally furnished and moderately spaced.
